meta.description: Ranked-plan item 2 (2026-09-26-milestone-b-nvt.md): FrameworkBatch build time and host-side byte footprint (Base.summarysize), and mc_step! cost per move at nsys in {1024, 4096}, before (commit e38352a, one copy of Shost/kmin/bs/etc. per system) and after (commit efa65a5, framework_of indirection, one copy per distinct framework) the dedup. RUBTAK 3x3x3 + 50 CO2/chain, fill(sc, nsys) (all chains share one Framework value). Build-time/bytes measured on CPU (4 threads, hardcore_bound's own Threads.@threads); move-cost measured on the RTX 4070 (Float32, MOVE_TRANSLATION, warmed on wall-clock time per the card's 210 MHz idle / 3105 MHz boost gap, median of 200 timed calls after warm-up).

move_cost_f32_cuda.note: mc_step! itself is byte-for-byte unchanged between before/after; the entire speedup is attributable to the deduplicated batch's much smaller device memory footprint making the shared host data L2-resident, which the ranked plan flagged as 'a real but unquantified second gain' — this is that measurement.
